284735240.description:
Maxell Blank Audio Cassette Lot - 3 Pieces
XLII 90 High Bias & UR 90 Normal Bias
Vintage Recordable Media
Lot of three factory-sealed Maxell 90-minute blank audio cassette tapes featuring the iconic "Blown Away Guy" packaging artwork. This collection includes two premium XLII Type II high-bias cassettes ideal for CD transfers and high-fidelity home recording, alongside one UR Type I normal-bias tape suited for everyday audio and voice recording. These vintage analog cassettes remain highly sought after by audiophiles, musicians, and mixtape enthusiasts for their reliable formulation and warm sound reproduction.
Items Included:
1.
Maxell XLII 90
- High Bias IEC Type II, EQ 70s, 90 min (135m), factory sealed
2.
Maxell XLII 90
- High Bias IEC Type II, EQ 70s, 90 min (135m), factory sealed
3.
Maxell UR 90
- Normal Bias IEC Type I, EQ 120s, 90 min (135m), factory sealed
Condition:
All three cassettes are new old stock and factory sealed in original cellophane with pull tabs intact. Cellophane shows minimal shelf wear with no tears or openings. Jewel cases and J-cards pristine inside.
